events.description: Tech or Treat is a Halloween-themed tabling event hosted by the Emerging Technologies Cabinet to connect students with AI and emerging technology resources at UF. Students who stop by the table will spin a prize wheel that awards either a "Tech" goodie (such as phone chargers, phone wallets, portable fans, USB A to C adapters, or fidget toys) or a "Treat" (small, individually wrapped candy). There will also be a “jackpot” slot of the wheel with top tech prizes, with a choice between selecting a reliable portable charger or a keychain tracker (similar to AirTag). After receiving their prize, each student will have a brief conversation with the Cabinet Director or an Assistant Director about ways to get involved with AI and emerging technologies on campus. Every participant will also receive a printed pamphlet highlighting opportunities such as HiPerGator, the AI Scholars program, the AI² Center, CURBS, and other student organizations and university-affiliated programs. The event ran successfully last year, and this year's goal is to reach 75–125 students and increase awareness of the university's AI resources among students outside technical majors.

Our commitment to inclusion across race, gender, ethnicity, religion, or any other aspects that make our members unique is what allows our club to strengthen and grow. The UF Women's Ultimate Frisbee Club Team was founded 19 years ago, originally as "FUEL" (Florida Ultimate Elite Ladies).

The club includes both FUEL and our B-Team, DIESEL. Any UF student is welcome to come out and play and we guarantee you'll have a great time. There is a spot for everyone! The majority of people who come out have never played before.

Both teams compete in 4-6 tournaments a year against other schools, mostly in the southeast. However, FUEL has traveled as far as California, Texas, and Colorado in the last few years for competition.

We are funded by the University, which covers the majority of our costs.

FUEL qualified for Nationals in 2006, 2007, 2011, 2012, 2017 and 2018. In their seventh year, DIESEL is the only B-team to have qualified for and played in Regionals, and they've done so twice.

Come join us for practice and see what it's all about!

The purpose of FISS on the Block tabling is to promote the Florida Invitational Step Show (FISS), increase awareness and excitement surrounding the event, and introduce students to the Black Student Union (BSU) department and its programs, resources, and opportunities for engagement.
 
We will be tabling every week on Tuesday and Thursday from 12:00 PM to 3:00 PM. I made reservations depending on availability, so there are days that we will be tabling in Turlington Plaza or Newell Hall.
 
Here are all the reservations.
  • September 15: Newell, 12 PM to 3 PM
  • September 17: Turlington, 12 PM to 3 PM
  • September 22: Newell + Turlington, 12 PM to 3 PM
  • September 24: Newell + Turlington, 12 PM to 3 PM
  • September 29: Newell + Turlington, 12 PM to 3 PM
  • October 1: Turlington, 12 PM to 3 PM
  • October 6: Turlington, 12 PM to 3 PM
  • October 8: Turlington, 12 PM to 3 PM
  • October 13: Turlington, 12 PM to 3 PM
  • October 15: Turlington, 12 PM to 3 PM
  • October 20: Turlington, 12 PM to 3 PM
  • October 22: Turlington, 12 PM to 3 PM
  • October 27: Turlington, 12 PM to 3 PM
